name: skill-code
description: House engineering standards: architecture, testing, review, security, git and infrastructure. The engineering-base plugin applies to any stack; stack plugins are installed per project language.

plugins.name: engineering-base
plugins.description: Language-agnostic standards: project context discovery, PR review, code and dependency security, concurrency correctness, gitflow, Terraform (AWS/GCP/Azure) and GitHub Actions.

plugins.name: python-fastapi
plugins.description: Python/FastAPI service standards: layered architecture with the manager pattern, concurrency and the event loop, unit and end-to-end testing. Install alongside engineering-base.
